name: Switch
description: A framework-free Web Component that draws a native checkbox as an on/off switch in CSS alone and adds a pending state for changes that have to travel to a server.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: A single switch shown off and on, at the standard and the compact size.

variants.name: Placement
variants.description: The same switch with its label after it and with the label leading a full-width row.

variants.name: Descriptions
variants.description: Settings rows that pair each label with supporting text referenced as a description rather than a name.

variants.name: Group
variants.description: A panel of related switches under a legend, reporting exactly what a submission would carry.

variants.name: Pending
variants.description: Switches backed by an asynchronous commit that lock while in flight and return to their previous state when the request fails.

variants.name: Restricted
variants.description: Unavailable switches in both the on and the off state beside a group that is disabled as a whole.
